overview_description.description:
Bitrise is a platform for mobile app development, enabling tens of thousands of developers to automate integration, testing, and deployment. Through 200+ integrations with the services developers know and love, Bitrise frees up developers to iterate and improve their workflows for ever faster and better results. It offers more than 300 steps and integrations to easily connect the processes and services you use in your mobile development workflows.

With tens of thousands of developers and customers spanning unicorn startups (Careem, Traveloka) to established enterprise companies (Virgin, TNT), Bitrise is the defacto standard for mobile CI/CD and automation.

about_short_description.short_description: Bitrise is a mobile DevOps platform built to adress mobile’s challenges, empowering mobile teams to deliver their best work.

product.name: Bitrise Mobile DevOps Platform
product.description: An end-to-end platform for automating mobile application build, test, release, and deployment workflows for iOS, Android, and cross-platform projects.

product.name: Bitrise CI
product.description: A mobile-focused continuous integration and delivery service for automating application builds, tests, code signing, and deployment workflows.

product.name: Release Management
product.description: A service for distributing mobile application builds to testers and app stores with approval controls, staged rollouts, and release automation.

product.name: Build Cache
product.description: A remote caching service that reuses compiled Gradle, Bazel, and Xcode outputs to reduce repeated work and shorten mobile build times.

product.name: Bitrise Build Hub
product.description: Managed, mobile-optimized runners for GitHub Actions that improve build execution without requiring teams to replace their existing CI workflows.

product.name: CodePush
product.description: An over-the-air update service for delivering React Native and Expo JavaScript and asset updates to users without submitting every update for store review.
